name: plugin.magika_content_detector
description: Google Magika deep-learning file content type, MIME detection, and batch directory classification engine

entrypoints.name: magika_identify_path
entrypoints.description: Identify file content type, MIME, group, confidence score, and text/binary flag from a file path

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Absolute or relative path to the file to inspect

entrypoints.name: magika_identify_bytes
entrypoints.description: Identify content type and MIME metadata from in-memory base64-encoded bytes without disk writes

entrypoints.name: magika_batch_scan
entrypoints.description: Scan and classify all files in a directory hierarchy with aggregated group statistics and confidence scoring

parameters.name: dir_path
parameters.description: Directory path to scan recursively or flatly

parameters.name: recursive
parameters.description: Whether to recursively descend into subdirectories

parameters.name: max_files
parameters.description: Maximum number of files to classify

entrypoints.name: magika_list_content_types
entrypoints.description: Query supported output labels, MIME types, and groups from the Magika knowledge base

entrypoints.name: magika_get_model_info
entrypoints.description: Retrieve metadata about the active Magika ONNX model, output dimension, and runtime features
